kinds.d: Snus in pouches, differing by whether the pouch is moist (original) or dry (white).

x.d: Founded as Ljunglöf's No. 1 by Jacob Fredrik Ljunglöf; about a fifth of Swedish snus sales.
Gothenburg recipe with juniper and herb tones, factory-made since 1919; white portion snus added in 1997.
Swedish Match's market-leading Scandinavian snus brand, sold in the US since 2009.
Snus whose 'Extremely Strong' variety has the highest listed nicotine content.

kinds.d: Moist, unportioned snus, often pressed into a 'pris' by hand.

x.d: Loose Ettan, 42 g can, 7.5 mg/g nicotine.
Coarse-cut snus (Grovsnus) in Swedish Match's main brands.

kinds.d: Tobacco-free pouch of plant fibre, nicotine (typically 1-10 mg) and flavour, placed between lip and gum.

x.d: Swedish Match pouch brand with over 70% of global share; first US sales 2016; FDA authorised 20 products in January 2025.

kinds.a: nicotine pearl · dissolvable tobacco · nicotine toothpick
kinds.d: Product that dissolves in the mouth or delivers nicotine without burning: lozenge, orb, strip, pearl or nicotine toothpick.

brands.d: Stockholm snus and match company; state tobacco monopoly of 1915 merged in, name adopted 1980, owned by Philip Morris International since 2022-23.

traditions.d: Moist steam-pasteurised tobacco placed under the upper lip, shifting from nasal snuff to snus by the early 1800s.
traditions.tech: Steam pasteurisation rather than fermentation; loose or portion
traditions.auth: Sold in Sweden under the EU exemption; most other EU sales of tobacco snus are banned.
